name: aspicio
description: Open, inspect, and render DXF and vector PDF drawings: MCP tools that describe and render them, plus skills for reading drawings and embedding the viewer.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and render DXF and vector PDF drawings
interface.longDescription: Describe DXF and vector PDF drawings as structured JSON (layers, units, bounds, entity counts) and render them to PNG images, via the @aspicio/mcp server. Bundled skills teach when to describe vs. render and how to embed the web viewer.
